question: Does Zhou Xiang 1569 public vol6 PDF page14 actually print day1 九五七二 as normalized by 13MY/13NA, or 九五二七 in the source-original photo?

source.work: 周相《大明大統曆法》卷六
source.render_contract: PyMuPDF Page(index=13).get_pixmap(Matrix(3,3),colorspace=RGB,alpha=False); source PDF bytes SHA verified. Native PDF raster is the authority; 3x render and ROI retain displayed glyph positions; no OCR.

date_controls.source_printed_title: 太陽冬至前後立成卷第二
date_controls.source_work_attribution: Zhou Xiang 1569-reprint route previously catalogued, not independently dated from this page alone

day1_short.glyph_note: The last two visible numeral glyphs are 二 followed by 七, not 七 followed by 二; compare same-page zero, one, two and neighboring characters without arithmetic normalizing the source literal.

broad_three_day_control.scope: Three date headings, two adjacent numerical field strips and same-leaf context, not three independent material witnesses

adjudication.positive: The 13MY source-local D1 decimal transcription should be 4.9527 for the photographed Zhou PDF p14 as currently directly legible, not 4.9572. The previously stated 13MY 19/19 constant short-step replay is not literal-source-exact on its own D1.
adjudication.conditional: The surrounding Zhou displayed values plus the independent G893 001a day1 printed 4.9572 support a likely numeral-order error in the Zhou displayed table, but its historical origin, compositor, manuscript ancestry and original impression cannot be determined.
adjudication.limits: Source-local glyph correction is not permission to normalize the original printed text in place, prove direct copying, equate historical field radix/epoch, or adjudicate any of six legacy historical G893 cross-edition numeric targets.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: The observed D1 opposition is edition/source scoped; copying direction and origin of transposed glyphs are not proved.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Source edition and copy identity for photographed Zhou text
Physical earlier witness D1 reading to determine whether Zhou is compositorial, received, or exemplar-line variation
G893 original same-field 少／微 precision/carry remains distinct and unbound

next: Prioritize original G893 same-field 少／微 unit/carry or a physical fifth/sixth 日差 digit. Only pursue Zhou D1 error genealogy if an independently physically bound early impression or adjacent worked rule resolves it; avoid duplicate four-digit replays.
